params.caption: 🎮 Slay the Spire 2 estimated at 7.9 million copies sold Mega Crit's roguelike deckbuilder is estimated to have sold about 7.9m copies since entering Steam Early Access in March, roughly a million for every month on sale. That puts it among the year's best-selling games, despite being available only on PC. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 14:33 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 🃏 React 👍 if you're hooked · 💬 How many hours have you sunk into it? #SlayTheSpire2 #MegaCrit #Steam #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
